name: French motorway tolls
law: Code de la voirie routière art. L122-4 and décret n° 95-81; tariffs set yearly by the concession contracts, as published by each operator: their tariffs in force from 1 February 2025, as the Internet Archive kept them, for APRR, AREA, Cofiroute, Escota. The other operators' documents of that year weren't archived, so their motorways aren't priced. A trip pays the published entry-exit prices along its route, excluding 20% VAT. Stations placed with the ministry's toll station dataset (data.gouv.fr) and OpenStreetMap.
